title: Broadway Bungalow ~ 5 Mins from Broadway
description:
This budget friendly home is a  5 min drive from Broadway. There is a gas station right across the street with all your needs, a hair salon, sports bar and a Hardees that you can walk to in 2 mins. Large concrete double driveway that will fit up to 8 cars. 3/4s of an acre with a large backyard for socializing or any event. Close to everything in the city, downtown, lakes, parks, shopping, and grocery. The home sits close to the interstate for transits and Ubers are affordable to get to anywhere.
